name: dogfood-redpanda-schema-registry
description: Dogfood app (v1.20-3) — a Redpanda + Confluent-shaped schema-registry pipeline that exercises 4 patterns (register 3 Avro schemas across 3 subjects + subject naming strategy / schema evolution across 2 versions of User with a backward-compatible added optional field / BACKWARD vs FORWARD vs FULL compatibility rejection surface / producer publishes payloads that fail-fast on incompatible schema register before publish) driven by @kiwa-test/streaming's RedpandaMock + SchemaRegistry mock in KIWA_MODE=mock and testcontainers-driven live Redpanda + Confluent SR in KIWA_MODE=real (env-skip REDPANDA_BOOTSTRAP + SCHEMA_REGISTRY_URL). Behavioural fidelity feeds @kiwa-test/quality-metrics 7-axis release gate.

scripts.test: pnpm -F @kiwa-test/streaming -F @kiwa-test/core -F @kiwa-test/quality-metrics build && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.vitest-dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.vitest.json && vitest run .vitest-dist/tests --environment node
